description: Reference-vs-reviewable presentation. Depends on FEAT-001. The scene builder styles only edges that have reviewStatus as status edges (zIndex 1, above reference edges) and renders every other edge as a thin muted neutral reference hairline (zIndex 0); nodes with no status (except the user) are flagged reference and rendered muted without ring/icon; a node that is both first-level and nested keeps its status because it comes from the user's first-level edge. Add the legend row 'Reference only (not reviewed)', optional tooltip status/reference lines, canvas reset keyed on graph.nodes, and CSS fixes (dead border rule, status ring kept on hover). All status maps stay exhaustive.
steps: Work only in /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.worktrees/review-status-fix. Read context.json, FEAT-001 findings, plan.md section 2 items 9-11.

Write/adjust tests FIRST and see them fail. buildAccessScene.test.ts: 'renders status edges above reference edges (zIndex)'; 'renders deeper edges as muted neutral reference hairlines' (solid, no dash, stroke var(--edge), strokeWidth 1, opacity < 1, class vc-graph-edge-reference, no status data); 'marks nested-only nodes reference and first-level nodes not'; 'a node both first-level and nested keeps its status and its nested incoming edge is reference'. Replace the old assertion that deeper edges have className undefined (about lines 163-205) with the reference-class expectation; keep the four status stroke/dash assertions (needsReview dashed var(--vc-warn) '6 4'; approved var(--vc-allow); revoked var(--vc-deny); reassigned var(--vc-accent) '2 3'). AccessGraphCanvas.test.tsx: 'legend lists a Reference only entry distinct from the four statuses'; 'every first-level card has exactly one icon equal to its card status and its incoming edge status'; 'nested-only cards have no status icon and carry the reference class'; 'stays in the drill-down when review statuses change but nodes are the same'; and a StatusIcon test 'renders a distinct shape and accessible name for every status' looping all four statuses. Keep every existing assertion (names render, icons by label, legend, no chip, no badge).

graph/buildAccessScene.ts: status edge when edge.reviewStatus -> existing edgeStyle(), className 'vc-graph-edge-status vc-graph-edge-<s>', data { reviewStatus, reviewMixed }, zIndex 1; otherwise reference edge -> className 'vc-graph-edge-reference', style { stroke:'var(--edge)', strokeWidth:1, opacity:0.45 }, data { reference:true }, zIndex 0. Node data: reference: node.kind !== 'user' && !node.reviewStatus; add reviewMixed. Keep the switch exhaustive over AccessReviewStatus; pathCount stays unused.

graph/AccessNode.tsx: add class `vc-graph-card-reference` when data.reference, `data-review-status` attribute on the card when a status is set, no icon when no status; pass optional status label / mixed / reference to NodeTooltip (labels from STATUS_ICON_LABEL). Node name + kind caption, aria-label and the grid-mode card are unchanged.

graph/NodeTooltip.tsx (+ NodeTooltip.css): optional props; when a status label is given add a 'Review status:' line (append '(mixed: some items still need review)' when mixed); when reference add a 'Reference only (not reviewed)' note. With no new props the rendered tooltip is unchanged (existing tooltip tests unmodified).

graph/AccessGraphCanvas.tsx: legend gets a fifth row (hairline swatch span `vc-graph-legend-swatch vc-graph-legend-swatch-reference`) labelled 'Reference only (not reviewed)', visually and semantically distinct from the four StatusIcon rows; reset selectedUserId when graph.nodes changes (track prevNodes) instead of when the graph object changes. Grid scene untouched.

graph/AccessGraph.css: add `.vc-graph-wrap .react-flow__edge.vc-graph-edge-reference .react-flow__edge-path{stroke:var(--edge);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:none;opacity:.45}`; `.vc-graph-card-reference{opacity:.78;border-color:var(--line);box-shadow:none}` (name/caption must stay readable in light and dark; existing tokens only); `.vc-graph-legend-swatch-reference{border-top-color:var(--edge);border-top-width:1px}`; delete the dead `border-left-color` declarations inside `.vc-graph-card-status-*`; add `.vc-graph-card.vc-graph-card-status-<s>:hover` rules so the status ring survives hover.

Run the new tests (they must pass), then `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`. Commit locally: `feat: render nested access links as muted reference-only in drill-down graph` with gate results in the message. Never push.
acceptance_criteria: In a built scene every edge either carries a status (class vc-graph-edge-<s>, zIndex 1, status colour) or is a reference edge (class vc-graph-edge-reference, no dash, no status data, zIndex 0, stroke var(--edge), strokeWidth 1, opacity < 1); no deeper edge is ever status-styled.

Nested-only nodes have data.reference true, no data.reviewStatus and render no status icon; first-level nodes render exactly one StatusIcon whose accessible name and data-review-status equal the incoming user edge status.
A node that is both held directly and nested keeps its status icon/ring; its nested incoming edge is reference.
The drill-down legend shows Needs review, Approved, Revoked, Reassigned and a distinct 'Reference only (not reviewed)' entry.
Existing tooltip tests pass unmodified; no text status chip; no pathCount badge; grid overview tests unchanged and green.
`npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` pass.
findings:
Reproduction (before source edits): 9 new/changed tests failed (4 AccessGraphCanvas, 5 buildAccessScene); StatusIcon test is a guard (passed). GATES after: vitest src/graph 50 passed; npm run build ok; npm run lint clean; npm test 259 passed / 34 files. Committed locally, not pushed.
FOR FEAT-003 (selectors):
- Status edge: RF edge group class contains 'vc-graph-edge-status vc-graph-edge-<status>' (edge id 'e:<from>:<to>', e.g. e:user:<id>:<nodeId>), zIndex 1, inline stroke var(--vc-warn|allow|deny|accent), width 2; needsReview dash '6 4', reassigned '2 3', approved/revoked solid.
- Reference edge: class 'vc-graph-edge-reference' (also CSS rule on .react-flow__edge-path: stroke var(--edge), width 1, dasharray none, opacity .45), zIndex 0, data {reference:true}. Every edge without reviewStatus is reference.
- Node cards: <article.vc-graph-card> now has data-review-status="<status>" when status set (both drill-down and grid card); reference nodes (non-user, no status) add class 'vc-graph-card-reference' (opacity .78, no ring). User card never reference. Status icon: svg.vc-graph-status-icon[data-review-status] (one per status card, none on reference cards).
- Legend: div[role=group][aria-label='Review status legend'] with 4 rows having svg.vc-graph-status-icon + a 5th row with span.vc-graph-legend-swatch.vc-graph-legend-swatch-reference labelled 'Reference only (not reviewed)'.
- Tooltip (optional props on NodeTooltip): 'Review status:' line (+ ' (mixed: some items still need review)') for status nodes; 'Reference only (not reviewed)' line for reference nodes. Existing tooltip tests unmodified.
- Canvas resets to grid only when graph.nodes identity changes. CSS: dead border-left-color in .vc-graph-card-status-* removed; .vc-graph-card.vc-graph-card-status-<s>:hover keeps ring. Note: hover on a reference card does not add the accent ring (reference rule has equal specificity and comes later); focus outline still works.
- New test file src/graph/AccessNode.test.tsx (StatusIcon four-status test).
